meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 触发后,Claude 会先确认你的重构目标,再并行扫描代码、构建依赖图、评估测试覆盖,制定分步计划,逐项修改并每步验证测试,最后跑完整测试和代码检查,产出重构后的代码及改动总结。
howto.when: 当你说出 “refactor”、“cleanup” 等触发词,或要求重构、清理代码时触发;开放式请求(如“改进代码”)会先追问具体目标。

say.text: 把 auth/handler.ts 的验证逻辑提取到单独模块
say.note: 将触发完整重构流程,先分析依赖再执行

say.text: 重构 AuthService 类,范围 module,策略 safe
say.note: 按指定范围与策略执行

say.text: 这段代码想清理但不知改哪里,帮我看看
say.note: 会先问你具体目标再行动

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude confirms the goal, scans code in parallel, builds a dependency map, evaluates test coverage, plans steps, applies changes with per-step verification, then runs full tests and checks, outputting refactored code and a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “refactor”, “cleanup”, etc., or ask to refactor/clean code. Vague requests will prompt for a specific goal first.

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in auth/handler.ts into a separate module.
Refactor the AuthService class with module scope and safe strategy.
say_en.note: Applies with given scope and strategy.

say_en.text: I want to clean up this code but don't know where to start.
say_en.note: It will ask for your specific goal first.
